summary: Bind compiled Python imports to verified manifest artifacts

delivery.outcome: Bind compiled-Python runtime import to the actual verified native manifest entry before loading; reject missing/unlisted/source fallback modules, preserve native semantics, add regressions and update the canonical standard. Publish and independently merge this exact bounded correction under repeated user request.
nonGoals: Change C ABI, Rust semantics, build schema, dependency pins or protected governance/Validator policy.
Release to registries, add platforms or migrate existing consumers.

architecture.decision: Use public importlib module discovery before import, require the chosen ExtensionFileLoader origin to correspond to an already hash-verified python-extension entry, then verify imported module origin. Reuse the manifest verifier and retain runtime API and fail-closed behavior.
architecture.rollback: Revert this bounded runtime correction through a separately reviewed protected PR; preserve reproduced failure and completed validation receipts.

validation.evidence: Installed wheel baseline reproduction executes an unlisted native extension despite valid listed hashes. Regressions reject native/source/missing/preloaded selected modules before unexpected execution.
Full real build/install and C/Rust/Python clients remain valid.
Canonical standard version/source/index/tracking correct; required governance checks and independent exact-head Validator approval/merge required.
